from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader
import subprocess

original_ref = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()

try:
    # Load at v1.0.0
    subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", "v1.0.0"], check=True, capture_output=True)
    old = GriffeLoader().load("mypkg")
    
    # Load at HEAD
    subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", original_ref], check=True, capture_output=True)
    new = GriffeLoader().load("mypkg")
    
    # Iterate and print breakages
    for breakage in old.get_breaking_changes(new):
        print(breakage)
finally:
    subprocess.run(["git", "checkout", original_ref], check=True, capture_output=True)
